fusions.name: Tunnelled Lunge
fusions.desc: A rat burrows ahead of you in a line up to 6 tiles long and comes up under the first enemy it meets for 8 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: The Hollowed Ground
fusions.desc: The undermined ground collapses under every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Spoil Heap
fusions.desc: Throws up a ridge of dug earth 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Bolt-Hole
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, you go to ground behind a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
